title: Introduction to Flamenco
text: The class is run by Elizabeth Luna in a small dance studio. She is a wonderfully warm person and very patient teacher. In one class she took me from complete beginner to dancing a short routine in Tangos style Flamenco. I felt that I learned a lot in a very short time and had a thoroughly enjoyable experience. I would highly recommend this to anyone who likes dancing, even if they are not very skillful, and who wants to experience a true piece of Andalusian culture.
author: Susan_H

title: Taste of Flamenco
text: I would like to thank Elizabeth Luna for an enjoyable and informative introduction to Flamenco. She was very patient and skilled at pacing the lesson to suit my limited experience. Her passion for both dance and teaching shone through. By the end of the lesson I had learned a short choreography which she videoed so I can watch again and practice at my leisure. It was definitely a pleasure meeting her and a wonderful feeling of expressing myself through dance.
author: susanhB7040RY

title: Great intro class
text: Elisabeth‘s class was a superb introduction to Flamenco for us novices. She was patient and inspiring. Great to see and learn some of the moves. Made watching Flamenco later on even more enjoyable. Thanks
author: Urs P

title: Excellent flamenco lesson Elizabeth is a fantastic teacher ,we all felt as if we had learnt a little more about the art
text:
First, we had a lovely drink in a bar just around the corner from the Studio, but in line of sight of the meeting points which is where the pedal bikes are parked. 
Elizabeth led us around to the dance studio which is in a rustic courtyard area, a hub for local creative artisans. 
If you are wearing trousers and have a scarf or sorong  bring it with you as you can use it to make your flamenco skirt!!
author: Alison_M

title: Terrific experience!
text: My friend and I greatly enjoyed this beginner flamenco class. Our teacher, Elisabeth, was amazing! The class was challenging, informative and most importantly fun. Would highly recommend!

title: Great flamenco dance class for beginners!
text: Teacher - Elisabeth Luna, met us promptly on the Plaza Pelicano. There were 5 people in the class - four of us traveling together and a 5th person. Elisabeth, who was assisted by another dancer, made all feel welcome. We walked a very short distance to a small dance studio. Elisabeth gave a very brief intro to Flamenco - the “philosophy” or “world-view” of flamenco. She then taught the class to perform a short dance - she is an excellent teacher.
